question: What is the meaning of building name in relation to building general information?
description: The building name is a property within the Building Core Vocabulary (BCV) ontology, which is part of the Building General Information (BGI) ontology. It represents the name of a building, which is a fundamental piece of information used to identify and refer to a specific building structure. This property is essential for organizing and retrieving building-related data within a digital building logbook (DBL) or other construction-related databases. The BGI ontology, as described in the provided text, serves as a foundational framework for defining and structuring building-related information, including the building name as a key attribute.
